identity: A 120-day hands-on path from fundamentals to strong DevOps, Kubernetes, AKS, reliability, retrieval and controlled tool-use engineering.

phases.name: Foundations
phases.summary: Linux, Git, HTTP, DNS, TLS, processes and evidence-driven practice

phases.name: Azure networking and identity
phases.summary: VNet, NSG, private access, DNS and identity foundations

phases.name: CI and delivery
phases.summary: Pipelines, artifacts, environments, OIDC and delivery portability

phases.name: Terraform and application
phases.summary: Terraform foundations, FastAPI, Docker and supply-chain basics

phases.name: Kubernetes
phases.summary: Workloads, networking, storage, scheduling, security and troubleshooting

phases.name: AKS
phases.summary: Azure networking, ACR, Workload Identity, Key Vault and monitoring

phases.name: Infrastructure delivery
phases.summary: Terraform modules/state, Helm, promotion, rollback and cost

phases.name: Reliability
phases.summary: Change gates, retries, SLI/SLO, alerting, incidents and evidence boundaries

phases.name: RAG and controlled tool use
phases.summary: Retrieval, citations, evaluation, policy checks and AI-infrastructure awareness

phases.name: Design and defence
phases.summary: Architecture, platform interfaces, trade-offs and closed-note war rooms

days.title: Contract, repo, honesty
days.goal: Set up the repository, learn the minimum terminal/Git flow, and establish how evidence is recorded honestly.
concepts: shell navigation and basic file operations
the first Git lifecycle: working tree → staging area → commit
days.capstoneConnection: `projects/forge-api/` starts the longitudinal thread.

days.title: Git recovery
days.goal: Recover local Git history without confusing pointer movement with history creation.
days.capstoneConnection: Use Git history as the capstone's version-control base.

days.title: Merge vs rebase
days.goal: Resolve a conflict and understand how merge and rebase change history.
days.capstoneConnection: Keep forge-api commits small enough to trace later failures to a change.

days.title: Linux permissions
days.goal: Control file access using ownership and mode bits without the `777` shortcut.
days.capstoneConnection: Record the permission model used by future forge-api scripts.

days.title: Processes and systemd
days.goal: Inspect process lifecycle and run a small service under systemd.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api will later depend on explicit process and working-directory assumptions.

days.title: First-10 slow-host triage
days.goal: Build a repeatable first-ten-minutes sequence for a slow Linux host.
days.capstoneConnection: Add the first operational troubleshooting habit to forge-api's evidence journal.

days.title: Logs as search
days.goal: Treat logs as queryable evidence rather than a stream of text.
days.capstoneConnection: Use the same evidence discipline in later Kubernetes and AI incidents.

days.title: Bind 127 vs 0.0.0.0
days.goal: Distinguish a running process from a reachable service.
days.capstoneConnection: [daily-learning/day-008.md](../daily-learning/day-008.md)

days.title: HTTP as a system
days.goal: Follow one HTTP request through its layers and status semantics.
days.capstoneConnection: The same path model will later be reused for AKS ingress and model/tool calls.

days.title: DNS and TLS
days.goal: Understand name resolution and certificate identity before debugging application behavior.
days.capstoneConnection: Record the request path assumptions that forge-api will rely on later.

days.title: health.sh
days.goal: Build a small deterministic health probe with meaningful exit behavior.
days.capstoneConnection: This becomes forge-api's first reusable operational artifact.

days.title: M1 mock + LLM sampler
days.goal: Understand the minimum LLM concepts needed to use AI without treating it as an authority.
days.capstoneConnection: [daily-learning/day-012.md](../daily-learning/day-012.md)

days.title: VNet / NSG / CIDR foundations
days.goal: Reason about Azure network boundaries, CIDR ranges, and NSG rules without accidental public exposure.
concepts: Azure CNI Overlay vs legacy kubenet awareness
days.capstoneConnection: This becomes forge-api's network-address planning baseline for later AKS networking.
days.next: D14 — Private Endpoint vs public PaaS

days.title: Private Endpoint vs public PaaS
days.goal: Compare private and public service access paths without confusing DNS with reachability.
days.capstoneConnection: Use the same path model in later Key Vault and AKS lessons.

days.title: Private DNS + Private Endpoint
days.goal: Understand how private DNS makes a private endpoint usable by applications.
days.capstoneConnection: Capture the DNS path that future forge-api cloud integrations will require.

days.title: Capstone path hop-by-hop
days.goal: Create a canonical request path that names every network and trust boundary.
days.capstoneConnection: [projects/forge-api/[projects/forge-api/PATH.md](../projects/forge-api/PATH.md)](../projects/forge-api/[projects/forge-api/PATH.md](../projects/forge-api/PATH.md)) becomes a capstone artifact reused throughout the 120 days.

days.title: Identity vocabulary
days.goal: Build the vocabulary needed to reason about humans, workloads, and permissions.
days.capstoneConnection: [daily-learning/day-017.md](../daily-learning/day-017.md)

days.title: Python foundations
days.goal: Learn the Python subset required for later automation without turning this into a general CS course.
days.capstoneConnection: This script is later reused by the failure parser.

days.title: CI as a contract
days.goal: Understand CI as a reproducible contract with inputs, steps, outputs, and policy.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api's CI will build from this contract in D20.

days.title: First pipeline
days.goal: Turn the health script into a reproducible GitHub Actions check.
days.capstoneConnection: This is forge-api's first automated gate.
days.next: D21 — Cache, supply chain, provenance words

days.title: Caching, artifact identity and provenance
days.goal: Understand what caches, SBOMs, digests, and provenance claims each prove.
days.capstoneConnection: Research anchor: GitHub artifact attestations establish signed build provenance. See [docs/RESEARCH.md](../docs/RESEARCH.md).

days.title: Environments / paved road
days.goal: Model environments as protected paths with defaults and explicit exceptions.
days.capstoneConnection: Forge-api's CI/CD path will follow this pattern.

days.title: Secrets and OIDC
days.goal: Understand secret storage and federation well enough to avoid copied credentials in CI.
days.capstoneConnection: [daily-learning/day-023.md](../daily-learning/day-023.md)

days.title: Change / rollback page
days.goal: Write a small production-style change plan with proof, rollback, and blast radius.
days.capstoneConnection: This becomes the pattern used for later Helm, Terraform, and incident work.

days.title: OIDC lab or blocker
days.goal: Apply the CI federation mental model in a safe lab or document a real blocker precisely.
days.capstoneConnection: Forge-api CI identity path is now connected to the future Azure path.

days.title: CI and delivery review
days.goal: Review the first half of the CI path and test whether the design transfers across common CI systems.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api now has a CI design that is understandable even when the delivery platform changes.

days.title: Terraform foundations
days.goal: Write a small Terraform configuration and understand configuration, provider, resource, variable, output, state and plan.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api gets a reproducible infrastructure definition before state, modules and cloud resources become more complex.

days.title: State, lock, backend
days.goal: Understand local state, remote state, locking, concurrency, and drift.
days.capstoneConnection: Research anchor: HashiCorp documents backend-specific state locking behavior.

days.title: FastAPI health and readiness
days.goal: Build the smallest tested HTTP service with separate health and readiness endpoints.
days.capstoneConnection: D39 can wire health as liveness and ready as readiness without inventing an endpoint later.

days.title: Dockerfile v1
days.goal: Package forge-api into a container and understand each Dockerfile instruction.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api's artifact moves from source to image at Day 30.

days.title: Docker internals
days.goal: Understand the process, filesystem, namespace, and resource boundaries created by a container runtime.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api becomes a containerized process with explicit runtime assumptions.

days.title: Multi-stage non-root
days.goal: Reduce image surface and run forge-api without unnecessary root privilege.
days.capstoneConnection: This hardens forge-api before CI and scanning.

days.title: Compose + Postgres
days.goal: Understand service composition, dependency boundaries, and persistent state using a local database.
days.capstoneConnection: Use the database as a stateful component for later troubleshooting concepts.

days.title: Container network isolation
days.goal: Control which ports are published and which services remain internal.
days.capstoneConnection: The same boundary thinking is reused in Kubernetes Services and NetworkPolicy.

days.title: Trivy + SBOM
days.goal: Scan the image and interpret vulnerabilities without turning scanning into a blind allow/deny ritual.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api now has an image-security evidence trail.

days.title: Tests still run + digest/provenance
days.goal: Connect tests, image identity, and provenance so the artifact tested is the artifact promoted.
days.capstoneConnection: Research anchor: GitHub artifact attestations provide signed claims about where/how an artifact was built.

days.title: Kubernetes control plane
days.goal: Understand the Kubernetes control loop and the responsibilities of its core components.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api moves from image to declarative cluster state.
days.next: D38 — Pod, Deployment, Service and workload choice

days.title: Pod, Deployment, Service and workload choice
days.goal: Understand Pods, controllers, Services, selectors, and when a Deployment is not the right workload primitive.
concepts: Deployment vs StatefulSet vs DaemonSet vs Job/CronJob
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api remains the long-running service; batch is a bounded learning fixture.

days.title: Probes and rollout
days.goal: Use separate liveness and readiness probes and observe how they affect traffic and restarts during a rollout.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api health endpoint now has an operational contract.

days.title: Empty Endpoints
days.goal: Diagnose a Service with no ready backend using selectors, labels, readiness, and endpoints.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api's first Kubernetes incident is an evidence-driven troubleshooting case.

days.title: YAML dry-run
days.goal: Validate Kubernetes manifests before applying them and understand what validation does and does not prove.
concepts: syntax vs schema vs policy vs runtime
days.capstoneConnection: Use dry-run as forge-api's pre-deployment guard.

days.title: ConfigMap, Secret and pod security
days.goal: Understand configuration separation and why Kubernetes Secret encoding is not a vault.
days.capstoneConnection: Forge-api later replaces the dummy secret path with Azure Key Vault/Workload Identity.
days.next: D43 — Requests, limits, QoS, quota, OOM and eviction

days.title: Requests, limits, QoS, quota, OOM and eviction
days.goal: Separate resource requests, limits, namespace quota, runtime OOM and node-pressure eviction.
days.capstoneConnection: The resource model becomes an input to later HPA, autoscaler and AKS capacity decisions.

days.title: HPA and scale-to-zero
days.goal: Understand how HorizontalPodAutoscaler chooses replica counts and how current Kubernetes versions can scale suitable workloads to zero.
concepts: resource versus object or external metrics
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api now has explicit capacity and readiness reasoning instead of treating autoscaling as magic.

days.title: PDB
days.goal: Understand PodDisruptionBudget as availability policy for voluntary disruption.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api's reliability model now includes availability during planned disruption.

days.title: NetworkPolicy deny
days.goal: Use namespace/network policy to express least-connectivity rather than relying on default allow.
days.capstoneConnection: Use the policy boundary later when modeling AKS ingress and secret access.

days.title: Ingress and Gateway API
days.goal: Understand Ingress for existing systems and learn why Gateway API is the current Kubernetes direction for new traffic-routing designs.
concepts: Ingress and IngressClass for existing systems
days.capstoneConnection: Update forge-api [projects/forge-api/PATH.md](../projects/forge-api/PATH.md) with the L7 boundary.

days.title: RBAC
days.goal: Use Kubernetes Role/RoleBinding and `kubectl auth can-i` to prove least privilege.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api later uses workload-specific service accounts.

days.title: Workload ServiceAccount least privilege
days.goal: Separate application identity from the default service account and prepare for cloud workload identity.
days.capstoneConnection: This is the Kubernetes side of the D66 identity chain.

days.title: kind vs real
days.goal: Know exactly what a local Kubernetes cluster can prove and what it cannot.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api uses kind for safe failure labs and reserves Azure claims for Azure evidence.

days.title: CrashLoopBackOff
days.goal: Troubleshoot a repeatedly failing container from events, logs, and prior logs.
days.capstoneConnection: Add the failure to forge-api's troubleshooting knowledge base.

days.title: ImagePullBackOff
days.goal: Diagnose image identity and registry access problems without reaching for admin credentials.
days.capstoneConnection: This prepares the AKS ACR identity path.
days.next: D53 — Pending Pod, PVC and scheduling predicates

days.title: Pending Pod, PVC and scheduling predicates
days.goal: Diagnose Pending workloads from scheduling and storage evidence instead of changing capacity blindly.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api remains stateless in its main path; storage is learned without turning the capstone into a Kubernetes database.
days.next: D54 — Ready, live, startup and cluster DNS

days.title: Ready, live, startup and cluster DNS
days.goal: Trace readiness and Service DNS together so an application can be healthy yet still unreachable.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api now has health and ready semantics needed for later traffic and incident diagnosis.

days.title: NetworkPolicy troubleshooting
days.goal: Diagnose denied traffic using policy, labels, namespaces, and port evidence.
days.capstoneConnection: Carry the learned selector debugging method into Azure NSG and private networking reasoning.

days.title: RBAC 403 troubleshooting
days.goal: Identify which identity and verb caused an authorization failure.
days.capstoneConnection: This reasoning becomes the model for Workload Identity 403 failures.

days.title: Failure catalogue
days.goal: Build a single troubleshooting matrix for the core Kubernetes failures learned so far.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api's incident knowledge now has a reusable local troubleshooting base.

days.title: Failure parser
days.goal: Turn raw failure fixtures into structured categories with small, testable Python code.
days.capstoneConnection: The parser becomes the deterministic component used in the later AI helper.

days.title: First LLM helper read-only
days.goal: Add a model-assisted explanation layer without giving the model cluster access or execution authority.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api now has a read-only AI boundary with no live write access.

days.title: M3 mock
days.goal: Cold-test Kubernetes troubleshooting, Python parser reasoning, and AI boundary discipline.
days.capstoneConnection: Gate before Azure: honest Kubernetes troubleshooting is the prerequisite.
days.next: D61 — AKS cost envelope + Automatic vs Standard

days.title: AKS cost envelope + Automatic vs Standard
days.goal: Understand the main AKS cost and control boundaries and distinguish AKS Automatic from AKS Standard.
days.capstoneConnection: Research anchor: Microsoft Learn documents Automatic as secure-by-default and Standard as more operator-configurable.

days.title: AKS create and destroy
days.goal: Create the smallest reasonable AKS lab, collect evidence, and destroy it safely.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api now has a real-cloud boundary, but no real production claim.

days.title: ACR push/pull
days.goal: Understand registry identity, tags, digests, and the image path from CI to AKS.
days.capstoneConnection: Connect the same digest built on D36 to the AKS path.
days.next: D64 — AKS pull with admin off

days.title: AKS pull with admin off
days.goal: Prove AKS can pull from ACR without a shared registry password.
days.capstoneConnection: Prepare for D66 where the application identity accesses Azure resources.

days.title: AKS application networking path
days.goal: Trace HTTP application traffic through AKS and distinguish Layer-4 LoadBalancer exposure from Layer-7 ingress routing.
concepts: Azure CNI Overlay and IP planning
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api's [projects/forge-api/[projects/forge-api/PATH.md](../projects/forge-api/PATH.md)](../projects/forge-api/[projects/forge-api/PATH.md](../projects/forge-api/PATH.md)) now has a complete application-networking boundary for later incidents.

days.title: Workload Identity seven steps
days.goal: Understand pod-to-Azure federation as a trust chain rather than a CLI recipe.
days.capstoneConnection: Research anchor: Microsoft Learn describes projected service-account tokens and OIDC federation for Workload ID.

days.title: Key Vault + Workload Identity
days.goal: Use the workload identity chain to retrieve one non-sensitive secret from Key Vault.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api replaces the local dummy-secret path with a cloud identity path.

days.title: Private AKS architecture paper
days.goal: Design a private AKS request path and identify what becomes harder operationally.
days.capstoneConnection: Extend forge-api [projects/forge-api/PATH.md](../projects/forge-api/PATH.md) with a private variant.
days.next: D69 — Node pools, taints and upgrade safety

days.title: Node pools, taints and upgrade safety
days.goal: Separate workload classes with node pools and scheduling rules, then reason about safe AKS node-pool upgrades.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api's AKS reliability story now includes disruption-aware maintenance and explicit capacity checks.

days.title: Cluster autoscaler words
days.goal: Distinguish Pod scaling from node scaling and understand their feedback loop.
days.capstoneConnection: Connect scaling assumptions to forge-api resource requests from D43.

days.title: KQL
days.goal: Use a specific Log Analytics table and time-bounded queries as evidence.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api operational evidence will later map logs to incidents.
days.next: D72 — OpenTelemetry three signals + AI calls

days.title: OpenTelemetry three signals + AI calls
days.goal: Understand logs, metrics, and traces and map model/tool calls onto the same observability model.
days.capstoneConnection: Research anchor: OpenTelemetry is a graduated CNCF project; GenAI semantic conventions remain development-status material.

days.title: Authorization: two planes
days.goal: Separate AKS cluster API authorization from pod-to-Azure data-plane authorization.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api will explicitly document both planes in its identity architecture.

days.title: Destroy and bill
days.goal: Close an Azure lab cleanly and turn cost from an assumption into observed evidence.
days.capstoneConnection: Close the first real-cloud forge-api deployment path before Terraform work expands it.

days.title: Terraform modules
days.goal: Design a small reusable Terraform module with a stable interface.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api infrastructure begins using modules instead of scattered resources.

days.title: Remote state
days.goal: Design state isolation and access patterns for multiple environments.
days.capstoneConnection: Tie remote state to forge-api's environment/promotion path.

days.title: Human Terraform plan review
days.goal: Build a deterministic human review checklist before AI reviews infrastructure changes.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api uses the review list before later small applies.
days.next: D78 — AI reviews a Terraform plan

days.title: AI reviews a Terraform plan
days.goal: Use AI to augment plan review without allowing it to override deterministic controls.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api's future plan-review helper remains proposal-only.

days.title: Apply small + rollback
days.goal: Execute one intentionally small Terraform change and demonstrate recovery thinking.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api infrastructure now has one real or simulated controlled change cycle.

days.title: Drift lab
days.goal: Detect and explain configuration drift between declared, recorded, and real state.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api's environment discipline now includes drift awareness.

days.title: Checkov
days.goal: Use static IaC checks as deterministic guardrails and understand their limits.
days.capstoneConnection: This is the deterministic layer beneath the future agent.

days.title: Import / move
days.goal: Understand how Terraform adopts existing resources and refactors addresses without accidental destruction.
days.capstoneConnection: Prepare forge-api for module refactoring without unnecessary recreation.

days.title: Module interface freeze
days.goal: Freeze a stable module contract before the capstone grows further.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api infrastructure has a predictable abstraction boundary before Helm.

days.title: Helm chart
days.goal: Package forge-api Kubernetes manifests with Helm while retaining YAML literacy.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api's Kubernetes layer moves from raw manifests toward controlled packaging.

days.title: Helm rollback
days.goal: Demonstrate a safe release change and rollback using Helm revision history.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api now has an application-release recovery story.

days.title: CI deploy path
days.goal: Connect source, tested image digest, deployment manifest/chart, and environment gate.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api becomes a build-once/promote example.

days.title: Cost review
days.goal: Review infrastructure choices for cost without optimizing blindly.
days.capstoneConnection: Carry cost awareness into the AI/token and observability phases.

days.title: PATH freeze + red boxes
days.goal: Freeze the known architecture path and mark unproven hops explicitly before introducing agents.
days.capstoneConnection: This is the capstone architecture baseline before AI automation.

days.title: Safety and change gates
days.goal: Put simple, deterministic quality and safety checks in front of runtime changes.
days.capstoneConnection: These gates protect the reliability exercises that follow.
days.next: D90 — Retry, timeout and idempotency review

days.title: Retry, timeout and idempotency review
days.goal: Use bounded retries and timeouts without creating duplicate side effects or runaway cost.
days.capstoneConnection: This concept becomes a hard guardrail in D99–104.

days.title: Define a measurable SLI
days.goal: Turn a user-facing reliability idea into a signal that can actually be measured from forge-api.
concepts: what the metric cannot tell you
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api gains its first measurable reliability statement.

days.title: Timeouts, retries, idempotency
days.goal: Design network retries that are safe for the operation being repeated.
days.capstoneConnection: This is the reliability boundary for the later agent loop.
days.next: D93 — Alert that pages a human

days.title: Alert that pages a human
days.goal: Design an alert that has a measurable trigger and an owner who is expected to act.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api gains an operational signal that later incidents can reference.

days.title: Incident tabletop
days.goal: Practice incident reasoning before automating diagnosis.
concepts: high availability vs backup vs disaster recovery vs rollback
days.capstoneConnection: This tabletop becomes the format for D95's real or simulated incident.

days.title: Incident record
days.goal: Turn one failure you actually observed or simulated into a useful incident record with evidence and recovery.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api now has a human-first incident artifact before AI-assisted troubleshooting.
days.next: D96 — Make the evidence boundary explicit

days.title: Make the evidence boundary explicit
days.goal: Make the capstone evidence boundary explicit so project work is never presented as something it did not prove.
days.capstoneConnection: This keeps later explanations tied to the evidence you actually produced.

days.title: RAG terms and chunking
days.goal: Understand retrieval-augmented generation as retrieval plus grounded generation over an explicit corpus.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api begins a single-stack local RAG path; no vendor database safari.

days.title: Retrieve, cite, poison test
days.goal: Measure retrieval quality enough to reject confident answers from the wrong or hostile chunk.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api's RAG corpus becomes the knowledge source for the review-only agent.

days.title: Review-only agent loop
days.goal: Build the smallest safe agent loop: proposal, schema validation, allowlist, deterministic policy, then a local/read-only function.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api's agent/loop becomes the central AI engineering artifact.

days.title: Deterministic policy checks
days.goal: Block unsafe tool proposals with explicit, testable rules instead of relying on a persuasive explanation.
days.capstoneConnection: This is forge-api's hard safety boundary before MCP.
days.next: D101 — MCP protocol and tool boundary

days.title: MCP protocol and tool boundary
days.goal: Understand what the current Model Context Protocol standardizes and where authorization and policy still belong.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api can model an MCP-shaped interface without giving it infrastructure authority.

days.title: Golden eval harness
days.goal: Treat AI behavior as testable software behavior with explicit expected outcomes.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api's `eval/goldens` becomes evidence for the agent, not just a code sample.

days.title: Injection lab
days.goal: Stress the RAG/agent boundary with direct and indirect injection fixtures.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api gains an adversarial security regression case.
days.next: D104 — Pin, kill switch and AI telemetry

days.title: Pin, kill switch and AI telemetry
days.goal: Make the agent stoppable, versioned, observable, and bounded in cost.
days.capstoneConnection: Research anchor: current OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions are still evolving; learn signals without coupling the curriculum to unstable attribute names.

days.title: AI infrastructure awareness
days.goal: Understand enough AI infrastructure to design around inference without becoming an ML training engineer.
days.capstoneConnection: [daily-learning/day-105.md](../daily-learning/day-105.md)

days.title: Design one-pager
days.goal: Synthesize the system into a one-page architecture that includes data path, trust, reliability, cost, and AI boundaries.
days.capstoneConnection: This becomes the capstone's final design artifact.

days.title: Paved road + exceptions
days.goal: Design a platform path that makes the safe default easier than the unsafe workaround.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api is the reference workload passing through the paved road.

days.title: Platform interface and self-service
days.goal: Turn the paved road into a clear developer-facing interface with safe defaults and explicit exceptions.
days.capstoneConnection: This is the project evidence boundary, not a new curriculum.
days.next: D109 — Architecture trade-offs and failure review

days.title: Architecture trade-offs and failure review
days.goal: Review the capstone architecture and expose assumptions that matter most during failure, scale and change.
days.capstoneConnection: This review bridges design work and the closed-note war-room drills in D110 to D120.

days.title: Closed-note Linux/Git
days.goal: Recover core Linux and Git reasoning under time pressure in a closed-note exercise.
days.capstoneConnection: Revisit forge-api only to repair identified gaps.

days.title: Closed-note CI/OIDC
days.goal: Cold-test CI contract, artifact identity, secretless authentication, and trust federation.
days.capstoneConnection: Map the trust chain back to forge-api.

days.title: Closed-note Docker/supply chain
days.goal: Cold-test container packaging, non-root execution, SBOM, digest, and provenance reasoning.
days.capstoneConnection: The forge-api image is treated as a traceable artifact.

days.title: Closed-note Kubernetes incidents
days.goal: Troubleshoot Kubernetes failures from symptoms to evidence in a closed-note exercise.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api troubleshooting corpus is the basis for the drills.

days.title: Closed-note identity/WI
days.goal: Cold-test the two identity planes and Workload Identity flow.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api's identity documentation becomes a defendable architecture artifact.

days.title: Closed-note Terraform review
days.goal: Cold-test whether you can BLOCK a dangerous infrastructure plan.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api's plan review is now interview-defendable.

days.title: Closed-note signals
days.goal: Cold-test observability, SLI, alerts, and AI telemetry reasoning.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api observability model closes the reliability loop.

days.title: Closed-note design
days.goal: Produce an architecture under time pressure with explicit trade-offs and boundaries.
concepts: actions the system must not take
days.capstoneConnection: Use forge-api as the reference implementation, not a fictional production system.

days.title: Closed-note RAG/agent/eval
days.goal: Cold-test the AI engineering chain from retrieval to bounded execution and evaluation.
days.capstoneConnection: forge-api's AI path is now a complete review-only system.

days.title: List remaining practice holes
days.goal: Convert the whole 120-day experience into a small, evidence-backed list of remaining gaps.
days.capstoneConnection: Forge-api freeze depends on the gap list, not on adding more features.

days.title: Final reconstruction and defence
days.goal: Demonstrate the complete system from memory and freeze the curriculum as an evidence-backed learning record.
days.capstoneConnection: Tag/freeze the forge-api capstone and the 120-day record.
days.next: After Day 120, use the gaps you recorded to choose the next focused topic.

gates.name: Foundation
gates.evidence: Git recovery, slow-host triage, process/service failure and HTTP evidence

gates.name: CI
gates.evidence: blank-file pipeline work, one failure, OIDC trace and CI portability review

gates.name: Containers
gates.evidence: multi-stage non-root image, runtime diagnosis and provenance reasoning

gates.name: Kubernetes
gates.evidence: empty EndpointSlice, CrashLoop, ImagePull/Pending/OOM or RBAC variation and unfamiliar diagnosis

gates.name: AKS / identity
gates.evidence: AKS path, ACR pull identity, Workload Identity trace, Key Vault result/blocker and cleanup

gates.name: Terraform / Helm
gates.evidence: state/lock, module interface, dangerous-plan review and Helm render/upgrade/rollback

gates.name: Operate
gates.evidence: measurable SLI, actionable alert, incident recovery and explicit evidence boundary

gates.name: AI / tool use
gates.evidence: grounding, injection test, schema/allowlist, deterministic block, evaluation and disable path

gates.name: War room
gates.evidence: unfamiliar failure, evidence-first diagnosis, safe mitigation, recovery verification and design defence

capstone.name: forge-api
